events.body:
Source: Forkmesh QA Bug Report FM-QA-2026-08-02 (BUG-05; supporting screenshot Fig. 1)
Severity: High
Area: 3D Interaction
Environment: Web (desktop and mobile)

## Summary
Camera movement, avatar rendering, and the in-world chat overlay respond with a noticeable delay after user input.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Enter the 3D world view.
2. Interact with the camera or scene by clicking or dragging, and open or use the in-world chat panel.
3. Measure the delay between the input and the visible response.

## Expected
The scene responds within a near-instant window, targeting less than approximately 100 ms of input latency.

## Actual
There is a perceptible delay between input and the corresponding camera, scene, avatar, or overlay response, making the world feel unresponsive.
events.title: 3D view responds slowly to user input
